column7: What To Do (Acceptance Criteria)
column12: Why?

column6: Home renders but lacks consistent empty/error/skeleton UX
column7: Add skeleton loaders, empty state (no teachers), and toast for fetch errors. QA across slow 3G and offline.
column12: Home screen empty/error states — Why: blank screens on slow/spotty networks cause churn. Do: skeleton loaders, explicit empty state + “clear filters” CTA, retry on errors. Gotchas: distinguish offline vs server 500; map React Query errors to friendly text; log to Sentry. Test: throttle to 3G; simulate 500/timeout/offline. Patch: patches/feat-core-ui-empty-error-skeleton-home.patch

column6: Filters present but partial and not persisted across navigation
column7: Persist selected subject/rating/fee/distance in global store; debounce search; show active filter chips; reset button
column12: All Subjects – filterable list — Why: persisting filters prevents frustration. Do: global store for filters, debounce 300–500ms, visible “clear all,” show active chips. Gotchas: reset pagination on filter change; avoid over-fetch. Test: apply filters → navigate away/back → filters still applied, results consistent. Patch: patches/feat-core-ui-all-subjects-persistent-filters.patch

column6: Profile shows core fields; some fields (courses, schedules) unwrapped or missing fallback
column7: Render all Airtable fields with graceful fallbacks, wrapping long text; add 'Contact/Book' CTA
column12: Teacher Profile – data completeness — Why: decision point for parents. Do: render all fields with fallbacks; wrap long text; badges (Verified/Top Rated); clear CTAs. Gotchas: bad image URLs; unit localization (km, VND). Test: profiles with nulls/very long bios/broken images. Patch: patches/feat-core-ui-teacher-profile-completeness.patch

column6: Form allows submit with optimistic local checks only
column7: Client-side schema validation (Zod/Yup), disable submit while pending, success/failure screens, and duplicate submission guard
column12: Booking UI – validation & UX — Why: avoid junk/duplicates; clarity on outcome. Do: Zod/Yup client schema, disable submit while pending, success screen with ref ID, duplicate guard. Gotchas: timezone, min age; server re-validates. Test: invalid inputs, rapid taps, mid-submit network drop. Patch: patches/feat-core-ui-booking-validation.patch

column6: Large lists may fetch everything; no infinite scroll strategy
column7: Implement React Query infinite queries; pageSize=20; pull-to-refresh; cacheTime/staleTime tuned; show list footer loaders
column12: List pagination & caching — Why: smooth infinite scroll + lower API cost. Do: React Query useInfiniteQuery (page≈20), footer loader, pull-to-refresh, tuned staleTime. Gotchas: reset on filter/location change; no dupes; correct end-of-list. Test: repeated scroll + filter swaps. Patch: patches/feat-core-ui-list-pagination.patch

column6: Teacher photos load without caching/resize discipline
column7: Use expo-image with caching, thumbnails + content-fit, CDN URLs if possible; prefetch top cards
column12: Image performance & caching — Why: images dominate bandwidth. Do: expo-image caching, thumb/blurhash, fixed heights, optional CDN resize. Gotchas: layout shifts; prefetch top N; handle 404s. Test: 3G scroll FPS and cache hits on revisit. Patch: patches/feat-ui-image-performance-caching.patch

column6: Most strings i18n; some hard-coded left
column7: Audit all screens; extract to i18n; ensure date/number formatting locale-aware; verify VI as default
column12: Localization coverage (EN/VI) — Why: VI default; consistency builds trust. Do: extract all strings; localize dates/currency/distance; ensure toggle re-renders. Gotchas: concatenated strings, plurals, subject keys. Test: toggle EN/VI across app; long VI labels don’t overflow. Patch: patches/feat-core-ui-i18n-coverage.patch

column6: App may crash without friendly boundary
column7: Add a top-level ErrorBoundary with reset action and Sentry report capture
column12: Global error boundary — Why: prevent white screens; capture crashes. Do: top-level ErrorBoundary with friendly UI + “Try again” and Sentry capture. Gotchas: safe reset of nav state; don’t hide dev errors. Test: force error; boundary renders; Sentry event appears. Patch: patches/feat-core-errorboundary-reset.patch

column7: Display offline banner and cached last-known list; retry button
column12: Offline fallback — Why: variable VN networks. Do: NetInfo banner, cached last-known lists, retry button. Gotchas: don’t confuse offline vs server 500; don’t write stale cache. Test: airplane mode → banner + cached content; recovery path. Patch: patches/feat-core-ui-offline-fallback.patch

column6: UI exists but reactions/comments are local or partially wired
column7: Wire to protected backend endpoints; optimistic UI with server truth reconciliation; abuse/report hooks
column12: Feed (posts, comments, likes) — Why: UGC needs server truth/abuse control. Do: protected endpoints, optimistic UI with rollback, rate-limit posting, Report" action. Gotchas: one-like-per-user server rule; sanitize text; validate uploads. Test: flood likes/comments

column6: Login uses Airtable password check; no Firebase ID token
column7: Implement Firebase Auth (email/password or phone OTP). Store session in React Native; signOut flow
column12: Firebase Auth enablement — Why: protected APIs need verified identity. Do: Firebase Auth (email/pass or phone OTP), ID token on every call, secure session & sign-out. Gotchas: token refresh; route guards. Test: protected endpoint 401 when signed out, 200 when signed in. Patch: patches/feat-auth-roles-firebase-auth-enablement.patch

column6: Users not linked to UID; backend can’t authorize by user identity
column7: Create secure function to upsert Airtable user record with Firebase UID on first login; prevent duplicates
column12: Airtable ↔ Firebase UID linking — Why: backend needs identity ↔ record mapping. Do: on first login, create/link Airtable user by Firebase UID; enforce UID uniqueness. Gotchas: email change; dup merges; first-login race. Test: new/returning/existing-row flows. Patch: patches/feat-auth-roles-uid-linking.patch

column6: No role claims; routes/components not guarded
column7: Assign custom claims on server; add route guards; hide admin-only UI; deny at API layer by role
column12: Role-based access (parent/teacher/admin) — Why: prevent privilege escalation. Do: set custom claims server-side; check claims in middleware + UI guards. Gotchas: refresh token after role change; never client-only checks. Test: parent attempts admin action → 403 and hidden UI. Patch: patches/feat-auth-roles-role-based-access.patch

column7: Add Forgot Password flow (email link) or phone OTP; throttle requests
column12: Password reset / OTP verification — Why: account recovery & trust. Do: email reset or phone OTP; throttle; audit events. Gotchas: SIM-swap risk; localized content. Test: valid/invalid recovery; lockout after many tries. Patch: patches/feat-auth-password-reset.patch

column7: Show ToS/Privacy on first login; store acceptance timestamp on user record
column12: Terms acceptance & age gate — Why: legal + minors. Do: show ToS/Privacy first login; record version + timestamp; collect parental contact for minors. Gotchas: localization; evidence storage. Test: re-prompt on policy version bump. Patch: patches/feat-auth-roles-terms-age-acceptance.patch

column6: Public /tables/:table endpoints allow read/write/delete by anyone
column7: Remove or protect /tables/* behind auth middleware; replace with specific, allow-listed endpoints
column12: Lock generic CRUD routes — Why: open /tables/* = anyone can read/write/delete. Do: remove or protect; replace with specific endpoints (e.g., /api/bookings/create) + auth/role + validation. Gotchas: CORS preflight; consistent error codes. Test: anonymous curl → 401/403; authorized limited to allowed actions. Patch: patches/feat-backend-api-security-lock-generic-crud-routes.patch

column6: No server-side validation on input payloads
column7: Add Zod schemas for Bookings/Reviews/Users; reject invalid; normalize data
column12: Schema validation (Zod) — Why: block bad/mass-assignment data. Do: Zod for all bodies (Bookings/Reviews/Users), strip unknown, enforce enums. Gotchas: keep client/server schemas aligned. Test: invalid/extra fields → 400 with clear message. Patch: patches/feat-backend-api-security-zod-validation.patch

column7: Add per-IP and per-UID rate limits; exponential backoff for repeated abuse
column12: Rate limiting & IP throttling — Why: protect from spam/abuse. Do: per-IP & per-UID token bucket; backoff after threshold. Gotchas: carrier NAT; admin whitelists; log hits. Test: scripted bursts → 429 then recovery. Patch: patches/feat-backend-api-security-rate-limiting.patch

column7: Set strict CORS allowlist (app bundle + admin console); block others
column12: CORS & origin allowlist — Why: reduce cross-origin attacks. Do: strict allowlist (bundle/admin domains), deny *, handle OPTIONS. Gotchas: preview and prod domains. Test: unknown origin fails preflight. Patch: patches/feat-backend-api-security-cors-allowlist.patch

column6: Airtable PAT exposed in .env and EXPO_PUBLIC_*
column7: Revoke old PAT; store in Functions config; remove from client; rotate regularly
column12: Secrets handling (revoke PAT) — Why: exposed PAT = immediate risk. Do: revoke; move to Functions config; remove from client; rotate; update .gitignore. Gotchas: scrub commit history/caches; kill old builds. Test: ensure bundle has no secrets; server reads config at runtime. PR: https://github.com/tageja/tuto1/pull/new/feat/backend-security/secrets-handling

column7: Create base-scoped PAT with read/write only to needed tables; no workspace-wide perms
column12: Least-privilege Airtable PAT — Why: minimize blast radius. Do: base-scoped PAT; only needed tables; avoid owner tokens. Gotchas: document rotation. Test: app routes still function with reduced scope. Patch: patches/feat-backend-security-least-privilege-pat.patch

column7: Log actor UID, action, table, payload hash to an Audit table
column12: Audit logs for writes — Why: forensics & disputes. Do: log UID/action/table/recordId/payload hash/time in separate “Audit” table, append-only. Gotchas: no raw PII. Test: create/edit/delete → audit row written. Patch: patches/feat-functions-audit-logs.patch

column7: Introduce /v1 prefix and keep contract stable; deprecate old routes gracefully
column12: API versioning — Why: safe changes/back-compat. Do: /v1 prefix; deprecate on schedule; doc versions. Gotchas: client pins; usage analytics. Test: v1 & v2 coexist during migration. Patch: patches/feat-backend-api-api-versioning.patch

column7: Add packages; iOS/Android permissions; simple map screen
column12: Install maps & location libs — Why: nearby discovery is core. Do: react-native-maps, expo-location, platform permissions, simple map + markers. Gotchas: Android Maps API key; iOS usage strings. Test: permission flow + render markers. Patch: patches/feat-maps-location-permissions.patch

column7: Handle ask/denied states; manual location entry fallback
column12: Permission flow & fallbacks — Why: many deny GPS. Do: rationale screen; manual area entry; cache consent. Gotchas: “Ask Next Time” edge cases; deep-link to settings. Test: deny path still usable. Patch: patches/feat-maps-location-permissions.patch

column6: Map performance poor with many markers
column7: Add clustering; show TeacherCard preview in callout; navigate to profile
column12: Marker clustering & callouts — Why: performance/clarity with many markers. Do: clustering; callout shows mini TeacherCard + CTA. Gotchas: tap targets; z-index; low-end devices. Test: 100+ markers pan/zoom smoothly. Patch: patches/feat-maps-marker-clustering-callouts.patch

column7: Server calculates distance from user coordinate; filter <=X km; sort ascending
column12: Distance filter & sorting — Why: parents choose nearby first. Do: server Haversine distance; <=2/5/10 km filters; sort ascending. Gotchas: units consistency; cached geocodes. Test: ordering against known coordinates. Patch: patches/feat-maps-distance-filter.patch

column7: Add deep link to Google/Apple Maps with coordinates
column12: “Open in Maps” deep link — Why: quick trust builder. Do: link to Google/Apple Maps with lat/lng + label. Gotchas: platform URL schemes; i18n address strings. Test: opens correct app destination. Patch: patches/feat-maps-open-in-maps.patch

column6: Schema is clear but not locked/versioned
column7: Publish schema.md (tables/fields/types); freeze v1; plan migrations
column12: Lock schema v1 (doc) — Why: avoid field drift. Do: docs/schema.md with tables/fields/types/relations; tag v1; migrate via scripts. Gotchas: hidden/formula fields. Test: CI check fails when unknown fields appear. Patch: patches/feat-schema-ci-legal.patch

column7: Enforce uniqueness & referential checks in Functions before writes
column12: Server-side constraints — Why: UI checks are bypassable. Do: enforce uniqueness (email/phone), enums (status), FK existence. Gotchas: race conditions; idempotency keys. Test: duplicates/invalid refs rejected. Patch: patches/feat-functions-server-constraints.patch

column7: Write seeds for Teachers/Parents/Bookings for QA/dev
column12: Seed & sample data scripts — Why: reproducible QA/dev. Do: seed realistic small sets; reset script; mark as seed. Gotchas: never seed prod. Test: fresh env loads fast with seeds. Patch: patches/feat-airtable-schema-seed-sample-data-scripts.patch

column7: Nightly export of key tables to GCS/S3; retention=30d
column12: Backups & export routine — Why: safety/rollback. Do: nightly export to GCS/S3 (CSV/JSON), encrypt, retain ≥30d. Gotchas: PII handling; restore drills. Test: restore to staging. Patch: patches/feat-airtable-schema-backups-export-routine.patch

column7: Add computed fields (avgRating, studentCount), and precomputed geo fields
column12: Indices / computed fields — Why: faster lists, simpler UI. Do: formula/rollup: avgRating, studentCount, geoHash. Gotchas: formula cost; keep simple. Test: list queries rely on computed fields.

column7: Create simple triage boards for new bookings, teacher approvals, reports
column12: Admin Interface (Airtable Interfaces) — Why: lightweight back office. Do: triage boards (bookings, approvals, reports) with restricted access. Gotchas: separate audit trail for admin edits. Test: admin approves; non-admin blocked.

column7: Add dev/preview/prod profiles; GitHub Actions for lint/test/build on PRs
column12: EAS profiles & build pipelines — Why: reliable releases. Do: eas.json (dev/preview/prod), GH Actions for lint/test/build, proper signing. Gotchas: keystore/provisioning secrets. Test: PR triggers builds; artifacts + rollback. Patch: patches/feat-schema-ci-legal.patch

column7: Define release channels; disable OTA for breaking native changes; document rollout
column12: OTA updates policy — Why: avoid native breakage via OTA. Do: channels, disable OTA on native bumps, doc rollout. Gotchas: users stuck on old binary; show “update available.” Test: preview channel OTA only. Patch: patches/feat-cicd-ota-updates-policy.patch

column7: Set package/bundle IDs, icons/splash, permissions strings, versioning
column12: App identifiers & store assets — Why: store requirements & trust. Do: bundle/package IDs, icons/splash, permission strings, versioning. Gotchas: 1024×1024 icon, correct descriptions. Test: store validation passes. Patch: patches/feat-cicd-app-identifiers-assets.patch

column7: Create test plan + release checklist (devices, locales, offline, slow network)
column12: Pre-release QA checklist — Why: prevent regressions. Do: checklist for devices/locales/offline/slow net/auth/booking/maps; assign owners. Gotchas: tie to build number. Test: run per release; bug capture with repro steps. Patch: patches/feat-cicd-pre-release-checklist.patch

column7: Draft App Store/Play text, screenshots, privacy labels
column12: Store listings (ASO) — Why: discovery/conversion. Do: titles, subtitles, long desc (VI/EN), screenshots, 15–30s video. Gotchas: kids/privacy claims. Test: beta review with 3–5 users. Patch: patches/feat-cicd-store-listings.patch

column6: Sentry wrapper present but DSN unset; no source maps upload
column7: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN via secrets; upload source maps in CI; verify crash appears
column12: Sentry DSN & source maps — Why: readable crash traces. Do: set DSN via secrets; CI uploads source maps; attach user/role context. Gotchas: env separation; avoid PII. Test: forced error shows readable stack. Patch: patches/feat-schema-ci-legal.patch

column7: Define events: search, profile_view, booking_start/complete, map_open; include user/role context
column12: Event taxonomy (analytics) — Why: comparable metrics. Do: central event map (search, profile_view, booking_start/complete, map_open) + user/role; version events. Gotchas: ad-hoc spam. Test: funnels have the needed events. Patch: patches/feat-analytics-event-taxonomy.patch

column7: Create dashboards for Search â†’ Profile â†’ Book; retention D1/D7
column12: Funnel dashboards — Why: see drop-offs. Do: Search → Profile → Booking Start → Booking Complete; segment by city/role. Gotchas: filter internal/bot traffic. Test: alarms on large drops. Patch: patches/feat-analytics-funnel-dashboards.patch

column7: Measure app start, time to first list, API p95; set SLOs
column12: Performance metrics (TTI, list time) — Why: perceived speed. Do: measure App Start, Time-to-First-List, API p95; SLOs + alerts. Gotchas: dev build noise; per-device class. Test: improvements after caching/pagination. Patch: patches/feat-analytics-performance-metrics.patch

column7: Show legal links in Settings and during onboarding; log acceptance
column12: Privacy Policy & ToS screens — Why: store compliance + trust. Do: link in Settings/onboarding; store acceptance (version/timestamp). Gotchas: VI/EN localization; keep updated. Test: re-prompt on version change. Patch: patches/feat-schema-ci-legal.patch

column6: Child users possible; no consent flow
column7: Add age gate; require parent email/phone verification for minors
column12: Age gate & parental consent — Why: minors. Do: ask age; if minor, collect/verify parent; restrict UGC until consent. Gotchas: store minimal data; false age edge cases. Test: minor flow triggers consent. Patch: patches/feat-schema-ci-legal.patch

column7: Add report/block on posts/ratings; admin review queue; publish content rules
column12: Report/block & content guidelines — Why: safe community. Do: report on posts/ratings, block users, admin review queue, public rules. Gotchas: abuse of reporting; rate-limit. Test: admin items created; repeat abusers blocked.

column7: Add account deletion and data export path; retention periods for UGC
column12: Data retention & deletion — Why: user rights/cost. Do: account deletion/export; set retention timelines for UGC. Gotchas: backups still hold data; document timelines. Test: deletion propagates to Airtable/backups per policy.

column7: Pick Stripe (global) or local VN gateway; test sandbox accounts
column12: Choose gateway & region setup — Why: monetization. Do: Stripe (global) or local VN gateway; sandbox accounts; supported currencies/cards. Gotchas: KYC, payout cycles, fees/refunds policy. Test: sandbox 3DS/SCA flows.

column7: Create /payments/create-intent; amount validation; currency; return client secret
column12: Create Payment Intent backend — Why: price integrity. Do: server computes amount; create intent; return client secret; pending row in DB. Gotchas: tamper-proof amount, rounding, idempotency. Test: multi-clicks → one intent.

column7: Use gateway SDK to confirm and handle SCA; show success/failure UI
column12: Client collect & confirm payment — Why: complete UX. Do: use SDK; handle SCA; clear success/failure; (optional) store last4/brand with consent. Gotchas: retries/cancel mid-flow; a11y. Test: declined/cancel/success paths.

column7: Handle payment.succeeded/failed; mark Booking paid; write receipt row; retry on failure
column12: Webhooks & reconciliation — Why: server is source of truth. Do: on payment.succeeded mark booking paid; write receipt; retry safely on failure. Gotchas: signature verify; idempotency; delayed events. Test: replay webhooks → consistent ledger.

column7: Implement partial/full refunds; permission-checked; audit log
column12: Refunds & admin actions — Why: trust & support. Do: partial/full refunds; permission-checked; audit trail; notify parent. Gotchas: time-limits; double-refund prevention; chargebacks. Test: refund updates ledger/UI instantly.
